layout.text:
OUR COMPANY

About Kanjay
Consulting.

HR and GeM portal consulting for small and medium organisations.

Kanjay Consulting works with businesses on their people, HR processes and GeM seller requirements. Our HR support is available globally; our GeM consulting supports sellers across India.

Talk about your business
OUR BEGINNINGS
2014
Kanjay Consulting established
2018
GeM consulting began

OUR AREAS OF WORK

People, processes
and the GeM portal.

HR / GLOBAL SUPPORT

For your organisation
and its people.

HR support for employers, with recruitment support also available to candidates.

HR audit, process setup, policies and documentation
Recruitment, payroll and applicable statutory compliance support
Performance management, engagement, onboarding and exit support
Explore HR support
↗

GEM / SELLERS ACROSS INDIA

For businesses selling
through GeM.

Guidance on seller activities within the Government e-Marketplace portal.

Seller registration, profile setup and catalogue support
Bid reviews, tender participation and documentation support
OEM authorization, vendor assessment, order and contract support
Explore GeM seller support
↗

Candidate enquiries: hr@kanjayconsulting.com.

HOW WE WORK

A mutually agreed
approach to your needs.

We work with clients through approaches agreed around their business needs.

For HR work, that can include reviewing records and processes, coordinating recruitment, and working with payroll inputs and documentation. For GeM sellers, our work includes document coordination, reviewing bid requirements, portal submissions and follow-ups.

These are the practical activities behind our consulting services.

OUR CORE VALUES

Trust. Quality. Support.
Trust

We see trust as the foundation of effective communication and client relationships.

Quality

We believe in a commitment to quality in the work we do.

Support

Our focus is on back-office support and long-term relationships with our clients.

WORK WITH KANJAY

Let’s discuss what
your business needs.

Speak with us about HR support or GeM seller consulting.

CALL US
+91 89397 15152
EMAIL US
info@kanjayconsulting.com
